correctness.rationale: For the stationary environmental rate, conditioning on its first redraw yields S(t)=exp(-mu*t)phi(t)+mu*(exp(-mu*.)phi)*S, hence R_mu(z)=g(mu+z)/(1-mu*g(mu+z)); 0<mu*g(mu+z)<1 gives positivity and finite stationary mean age. Conditional Brownian isometry for overlapping intervals since the last position reset gives C_mu(t)=2D integral_t^infinity S_mu(s)ds. Tonelli and derivative g prime=-h yield tau=h(mu)/(g(mu)*(1-mu*g(mu))). Beta-integrals at f(lambda)~c lambda^(alpha-1) give five regimes, alpha=1 and 2 boundaries and normalizations. For 0<alpha<1, the normalized survival-weighted law rescaled by mu converges via Laplace transforms to Gamma(1-alpha,1), proving the incomplete-gamma correlation profile; for alpha=1, e^-mu*t phi(t)<=S_mu(t)<=phi(t) and an O(1) integrated error on t<=O(1/mu) give the log-lag (1-q)+ profile. Independently checked resolvent and integrated correlation by two-rate killed-generator inverses at six parameter pairs. This algebraic check is finite corroboration, not a proof of the singular limits.
